activity_summary: Burbage came at the Welsh shore too loud, fighting Phillips, and would not hold the roll or have Garnish in his ear. He said give him the long one again, and not to read it. You gave it, and then told him half the voice, and to watch it as from a gallery, as if it were happening to someone he was sorry for. Kemp was not called.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Gave the line, and gave the half-voice.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Played it too loud, refused the roll, and was told to watch it as from a gallery.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Refused to be shouted down, and offered to be the news.

entities.name: Richard Cowley
entities.context: Named his six lines, and was told to wait for them.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Kept the pen dry, and did not send for Kemp.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Not called. Not in the rehearsal.

facets.activity: Told Burbage half the voice on the Welsh shore

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: Give me the long one again. No, don't read it, give it to me.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Half the voice, and watch it all as if from a gallery seat
